in_urdu.name: ملکوت

in_english.name: Malakoot
in_english.long_meaning: Malakoot is one of the beautiful names of Allah in Islam, meaning divine sovereignty, kingdom, and power. It is derived from the Arabic root 'malaka' which means 'to possess' or 'to have dominion'. This name is mentioned in the Quran, such as الحمدلله الذی له ملک السماوات والارض, signifying Allah's absolute power and dominion over all creation. It reflects the concept of Tawhid (oneness with God) and the belief in Allah's comprehensive authority

It is also a source of inspiration and motivation for many Muslims, as they strive to purify their souls and attain a place in Jannah (heaven) by emulating the virtuous conduct of angels.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Malakoot is considered the ultimate destination for the righteous souls in Islam. This belief in the eternal existence and spiritual growth beyond our physical reality serves as a powerful source of hope, comfort, and reassurance for Muslims, allowing them to face life's challenges with greater resilience and faith.
